description: Get domain details including URL, linked deployment, labels, and `status`: the one word saying what the domain needs from its owner (`unverified`, `unlinked`, `live`, `paused`).

domain.description: Domain name (e.g. "www.example.com"). Use domains_list to find names.

name: domains_get

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the domain was created.

deployment.description: The deployment hostname this domain points to; null when reserved but not yet linked.

labels.description: Labels attached to the domain; empty when none.

linked.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when a deployment was last linked; null if never linked.

links.description: How many times a deployment has been linked to this domain.

paused.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when plan enforcement paused serving; null while the plan has room for it.

status.description: What this domain needs from its owner, derived: "live" serves the linked deployment and needs nothing; "unlinked" is verified with nothing published there, so link a deployment; "unverified" needs its DNS records configured; "paused" means the plan no longer has room for it. Read this word rather than recomputing it. One of: live, unlinked, unverified, paused.

verification.description: How far DNS verification has got: "pending" is the site's CNAME not pointing here, "partial" is a www domain's CNAME pointing here without its apex A record (the redirect), "verified" is every required record. The diagnostic under "unverified"; ShipStatic domains are born verified. One of: pending, partial, verified.

verifications.description: How many DNS verification attempts this domain has had.

verified.description: When DNS last became verified; null if it never has, and never cleared, so a domain whose records moved away keeps it. Read `verification` for whether DNS is right now.

title: Get Domain
